Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Check Screen Before Waiting: Add a new screen new_desktop_visibility right before waiting to confirm desktop render permissions and multi-monitor display compatibility. (why: Support mail highlighted issues where pets do not show on desktop or the app will not open upon reaching home.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Choose Path Mascot Greeting Sub-Flow: Introduce a new mascot introduction screen new_path_intro before path selection that explains creation choices interactively. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s and dropoff (76.2% conversion), indicating users are hesitant about path choices.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Two Column Layout for Choose Path Screen: Switch the choose path screen layout to two_column with choice cards side-by-side for direct comparison. (why: Median time on choose_path is 8s while mean is 514s; a side-by-side comparison reduces cognitive load and path confusion.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery & Existing Pet Account Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign in screen reminding returning users to sign into their original account to preserve existing pets. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different email or account.)
4: [home, wait_info] Estimated Countdown Time Estimate on Waiting Screen: Enable time estimate and step counter on the waiting screen while pet assets are generated. (why: Home step has a high mean duration (2336s) and dropoff, where clear waiting time expectations prevent users from closing the app.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Arrival Notification Toggle on Home Intro: Enable notify_when_ready on home_intro so users receive a desktop notification when setup finishes. (why: Finish step mean duration is 5815s; notifying users when the pet is active brings them back to the desktop.)
6: [adoption, copy] Custom Pet Photo Requirements Clarification Headline: Update the headline and body of upload_photos to explicitly state clear lighting and single-subject photo requirements. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong due to improper source photos.)

Clear countdown expectations reduce abandonment during the 2336s home wait.

Clear photo requirements reduce technical creation failures during adoption.
